EG–84
ENGINE – ENGINE MECHANICAL

25. A/T:
DISCONNECT TRANSMISSION CONTROL ROD
Remove the nut, and disconnect the control rod from the shift lever.

P11535

26. M/T:
REMOVE TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER
(a) Remove the bolt and nut.
(b) Remove the transmission shift lever, inside of vehicle.
27. PLACE JACK UNDER TRANSMISSION
NOTICE (A/T): Be sure to put a wooden block between the jack and the transmission oil pan to prevent damage.

Q04104

28. REMOVE REAR SUPPORT MEMBER
(a) Remove the 4 nuts holding the member to the engine rear mounting insulator.
(b) Remove the 4 bolts and rear support member.

P11525

29. REMOVE ENGINE AND TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLY FROM VEHICLE
(a) Attach the engine hoist chain to the 2 engine hangers.

P11497

(b) Remove the 2 nuts holding the engine front mounting insulators to the front suspension crossmember.

P11531
